definitions.explanation: The medical procedure of transferring blood or blood products from one person to another.

examples.japanese: {手術|しゅじゅつ}{中|ちゅう}に{輸血|ゆけつ}が{必要|ひつよう}になった。
examples.english: A blood transfusion became necessary during the surgery.

examples.japanese: {輸血|ゆけつ}のおかげで{命|いのち}が{助|たす}かった。
examples.english: The blood transfusion saved my life.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{事故|じこ}の{後|あと}、{大量|たいりょう}の{輸血|ゆけつ}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: She received a large blood transfusion after the accident.

notes:
USAGE: {輸血|ゆけつ} is used both as a noun and with する as a suru-verb.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{輸血|ゆけつ}を{受|う}ける (to receive a blood transfusion)
・{輸血|ゆけつ}する (to give a blood transfusion)
・{輸血|ゆけつ}が{必要|ひつよう} (a transfusion is necessary)

RELATED MEDICAL TERMS:
・{献血|けんけつ} - blood donation
・{採血|さいけつ} - blood drawing, taking blood
・{血液型|けつえきがた} - blood type
